candidate_windows.window_text: We benchmark two types of LLMs: (1） standard LLMs, including open-source models such as Gemma 3 (Kamath et al., 2025), Llama 3 (Dubey et al., 2024),and Qwen3 (Team, 2025), as well as proprietary models such as Gemini $1 . 5 \mathrm { P r o }$ (Reid et al., 2024), Gemini 2.0 Flash Lite², Gemini 2.0 Flash, GPT $4 . 1 \ \mathrm { m i n i } ^ { 3 }$ ， and GPT-4.1; (2) reasoning LLMs, including the open-source Qwen3 with thinking enabled, and proprietary models such as Gemini 2.5 Flash, Gemini $2 . 5 ~ \mathrm { P r o }$ ,and o4-mini. For completeness,we also include a naive baseline named Random by randomly selecting one answer from the potential answer candidates (choosing one of 24 hours and one of 7 days for short and long problems, respectively). We employ accuracy as evaluation metric. For standard LLMs,we report accuracies using greedy decoding, while for reasoning models,we run each of them 3 times with default configuration and report the average numbers4. We also benchmark standard LLMs when they are coupled with Chain-of-Thought (CoT) prompting (Wei et al., 2022). We provide more implementation details in Appendix A.

All experiments of open-source models are run with PyTorch (Paszke et al., 2019) and vLLM (Kwon et al., 2023) on a machine with 96 CPU cores and 4 $\times$ Nvidia H100 GPU each with 94GB.For Gemini models, we run them with Google's python-genai5 API. For OpenAI models,we run with OpenAI's openai-python API.

We also list the detailed model versions used in our experiments.

Open-Source Models. We use official repositories of Gemma 3 family, including Gemma 3 1B it7,Gemma 3 4B it8, Gemma 3 12B it and Gemma 3 27B it10.We use official repositories of LLaMA famility, including LLaMA 3.1 8B Instructl1, LLaMA 3.1 70B Instruct1² and LLaMA 3.3 70B Instruct13 We use official repositories of Qwen3 family, including Qwen3 $\boldsymbol { 4 \mathrm { B } ^ { 1 4 } }$ , Qwen3 $8 \mathrm { B } ^ { 1 5 }$ , Qwen3 $1 4 \mathrm { B } ^ { 1 6 }$ and Qwen3 $3 2 \mathrm { B } ^ { 1 7 }$ .

Proprietary Models. For Gemini models,we use: gemini-1.5-pro-002, gemini-2.0-flash-lite-001, gemini-2.0-flash-O01, gemini-2.5-flash-preview04-17 and gemini-2.5-pro-preview-05-06. For OpenAI models, we use: gpt-4.1-mini-2025-04-14, gpt4.1-2025-04-14 and o4-mini-2025-04-16.
